title: Lapu-Lapu schools can now independently suspend classes amid El Niño

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — School heads in Lapu-Lapu City can now independently suspend face-to-face classes or adjust school schedules based on actual classroom conditions as the city prepares for the anticipated effects of the 2026–2027 Super El Niño. The Department of Education (DepEd) Division of Lapu-Lapu City formalized the policy through Division Memorandum No. 776, s. 2026, giving school heads the authority to make localized decisions without waiting for prior approval from the Schools Division Superintendent. The measure prioritizes classroom safety while allowing schools to sustain learning through alternative delivery arrangements whenever conditions permit. READ: Classes amid El Niño: Cebu City […]...
